transcription.credits: Patty Hill / Mildred J. Hill, as printed on the page
transcription.notes: No pickup: this arrangement puts the two opening eighths on beat 1, so every bar is a full 96 units. The left-hand chords are in the companion file happy-birthday-piano.music.json; this encoding is one line and cannot hold them. Bar 6 reads C5 B4 A4 (three quarters) — a third note where the most common version has only C B, so it is the one bar worth checking against the page.
transcription.tempo_note: The page carries no tempo mark. 120 is a guess and affects playback only.
